newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian pilgrim bus crashes into cafe, killing one.
newsitem.headline: Italian pilgrim bus crashes into cafe, killing one.

text.p: One woman was killed and 20 people were injured when a coach carrying pilgrims from a Roman Catholic shrine slammed into a sidewalk cafe, Italian television reported on Saturday.

The bus, which was returning to the southern city of Foggia after a trip to Lourdes in France, crashed into a cafe in the picturesque port town of San Remo late on Friday after its brakes suddenly failed.
A pedestrian, identified as 26-year-old Delia Cantagallo, was pronounced dead on the scene, television said.
The pilgrims had just visited Lourdes, considered by many Catholics a place of miracle healing, and were making a brief stopover in San Remo.

The most seriously injured were a German family who had been inside the cafe and the bartender, who suffered burns when the espresso machine landed on top of him, television said. None of them was in critical condition.
